nodes.name: Build evidence pack and review queue

parameters.content:
## Outcome

A user submits one research question through an n8n form. The workflow searches Google and Bing, canonicalizes and deduplicates results, limits repeated domains, extracts selected pages, retries failed pages with browser rendering, and creates a downloadable Markdown evidence pack.

The output preserves source URLs and extraction metadata. It is research input, not automatically verified truth.

## Get and connect a SearchCans API key

1. Open https://www.searchcans.com/register/ and create an account.
2. Open https://www.searchcans.com/dashboard/api-keys/.
3. Copy the Primary Key, or choose **Create New Key**, name it `n8n`, then copy it.
4. In n8n, open **Credentials → New credential → Header Auth**.
5. Set **Name** to `Authorization`.
6. Set **Value** to `Bearer YOUR_SEARCHCANS_API_KEY`, replacing the placeholder with the copied key.
7. Attach that credential to all four SearchCans HTTP Request nodes.

Never paste the key into a Set node, Code node, form field, or sticky note. The exported template contains no credential ID or secret.

## Source selection

Google and Bing run as separate discovery channels. The ranking step canonicalizes tracking parameters, merges duplicate URLs, rewards cross-engine agreement, and limits repeated hostnames.

`maxSources` accepts 2–6. `maxPerDomain` accepts 1–2. The default selects four sources from different domains. The workflow also retains People Also Ask questions and related searches when available.

## Extraction, review, and download

Sources run one at a time. Each URL first uses standard Reader mode; browser rendering runs only when the standard response has no usable Markdown.

The report includes coverage counts, a source manifest, excerpts, People Also Ask data when available, and a manual-review queue for failed pages. The final **Create Markdown evidence pack** node converts `researchPackMarkdown` into the binary file `searchcans-evidence-pack.md`. Open that node after execution to download it.
